app.name: Jamin
app.tagline: Peer-to-peer trade escrow for BCH and PUSD, written in SolidCash.

home.title: Sell BCH or PUSD to a stranger for cash. A contract holds the coins until you are paid.
home.lede: The seller locks the coins in a SolidCash contract. The buyer pays by bank transfer or in cash and marks it paid. The seller releases the coins, or an arbitrator decides. Nobody holds the coins in between.
home.actionTitle: Run a trade in your browser
home.actionNote: The real compiled contract on a simulated network. Play seller, buyer and arbitrator. No wallet needed.
home.artTitle: A seller and a buyer either side of a locked box holding the coins
home.judge1: Start a trade and act as each role. Wrong moves come back with the contract's own error name.
home.judge2: See the transactions recorded on a real network.
home.judge3: Read the contract and each SolidCash feature it uses, with the test that runs it.
home.how1: The seller creates the escrow and deposits the amount plus the trade fee. Only the contract can move them now.
home.how2Title: 2. The buyer pays and marks it paid
home.how2: The buyer pays outside the chain and signs "marked as paid". From then on the seller cannot cancel.
home.how3: The seller releases the coins to the buyer. If they disagree, either side opens a dispute with a fee, and the arbitrator picks the winner.
home.limit1: Hackathon build, not audited. Nothing you do in the simulator is broadcast.
home.limit2: While a dispute is open, only the arbitrator can settle the trade.
home.limit3: A closed escrow keeps {reserve} sats (and one token unit for a token trade): the contract needs them to exist.

try.title: Try a trade
try.lede: This runs the compiled Jamin contract on the SolidCash mock network with Bitcoin Cash size limits. Keys are made up in this page and thrown away.
try.empty: Start a trade to see its transactions here.
try.panelNote: Disputes are decided by a panel of three keys. Any two of them must sign; you are member A.

cosign.B: Member A and member B (2 of 3)

try.walletNote: A demo wallet in this page answers the BCH WalletConnect requests bch_signTransaction and bch_signMessage, as a phone wallet does. It pays for the seller's transactions and signs their coins. The escrow's seller key comes from the wallet's signature over this message:
try.walletLimit: Connecting a phone wallet needs a WalletConnect relay id, which this site does not have yet.

sellerCancel.label: Cancel as seller
sellerCancel.who: seller, after the waiting time, if unpaid

openDispute.label: Open a dispute
openDispute.who: buyer or seller, after marked paid

log.waited: The simulated clock moved past the seller's waiting time.

errors.InvalidAmount: The amount must be above zero.
errors.InvalidDisputeFee: The dispute fee is not valid.
errors.InvalidCancelTime: The waiting time is not valid.
errors.NotSeller: Only the seller's signature can do this.
errors.NotBuyer: Only the buyer's signature can do this.
errors.NotArbitrator: Only two of the three arbitration panel signatures can do this.
errors.NotFunded: The coins are not locked yet.
errors.WrongDeposit: The deposit is not exactly amount plus fee.
errors.NotOpen: The trade is no longer open for this.
errors.AlreadyMarkedPaid: The buyer has already marked it paid, so the seller cannot cancel.
errors.TooEarly: The seller's waiting time has not passed yet.
errors.NotPaid: A dispute needs the trade to be marked as paid first.
errors.WrongDisputeFee: The dispute fee paid is not the agreed amount.
errors.AlreadyPaidDispute: This side has already paid its dispute fee.
errors.NoDispute: There is no open dispute to decide.
errors.WrongToken: That is not the token this escrow holds.

terms.waitLeft: in {minutes} min, if not marked paid

contract.title: The contract
contract.lede: Two SolidCash contracts share one base: JaminEscrow holds BCH, JaminTokenEscrow holds a CashToken such as PUSD. Ported from OpenPeerEscrow (MIT).

footer.what: Jamin means guarantee in Malay. Built for BCH BLAZE 2026.
